test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A) The Covid-19 pandemic can be ascribed with advancing more new learning trends that are enduring, even though the pandemic is nearly over.

B) The submerging of e-learning in the educational process has resulted in an indisputable decrease in attention span.

C) E-learning or online learning is undoubtedly a trend that will persist even after the pandemic ends, simply as it provides so many benefits .

D) The attention span of learners has been restricted to 18 to 20 minutes (approx.) during the Covid-19 phase.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Covid-19 pandemic, as mentioned in sentence A, sets up a crucial context for this paragraph. It introduces us to the setting in which the other events are taking place. Therefore, sentence A should be the starting statement.
 
• Sentence C develops the idea introduced in sentence A, stating that e-learning or online learning is a trend that will persist. So it logically follows after statement A.
 
• Sentence B introduces a negative consequent i.e., a decrease in attention span due to the adoption of e-learning. Therefore, it follows C logically.
 
• Lastly, the precise attention span of learners during the pandemic is specified in sentence D. This serves as an example or proof of the statement made in sentence B and hence, comes after B.

Therefore, the correct arrangement is ACBD.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options fail to arrange the sentences logically.
 
• Option 1 (ABDC) fails to develop the e-learning trend mentioned in A before discussing its negative consequence in B.
 
• Option 2 (DBAC) starts with detailing the effect (D) before properly introducing the cause and context.
 
• Option 3 (DBCA) also starts with the negative effect (D), which disgorges the logical flow.
